capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系→卡伦尼，在雾气石林挑战，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 谱尼圣堂之门消强→圣光气→圣灵魔闪光输出；倒下后斯加尔卡电闪光滑阵自杀，达鲁切尔、魔焰猩猩、吉米丽娅强化后大招轮流输出，雷伊收尾；换人可重置它的叠加强化。

engine_notes: infinite_pp: the boss's skills never run out of PP (players could not win by 耗PP).
immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts). (4399: 海洋之心无效(全部miss))
lifesteal: heals 1/3 of the damage its attacks deal.

escalate_vs_same_foe: while it keeps fighting the same player pet, after each of its attacks its atk and spa rise (攻击和特攻自动强化，下一回合攻击技能造成的伤害大幅提升); assumed +1/+1 per turn, reset when the player switches pets.
速度极其缓慢 — encoded as spe x0.5 (estimate).

skills: all four are named by a period guide (聚侠 2012-04-07, 常用技能) and all four appear in the Boss's battle log in 4399's 2012 fight video (id 116640); they equal species 1147's last four at or below Lv80.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.

Immune to stat drops: Default per user 2026-10-21 (哈莫雷特及以后多数boss都免疫弱化和自带攻击+2); no period source tests drops. No innate boost: 4399 2012-04-07 由于卡伦尼没有强化 (its per-turn rise is escalate_vs_same_foe). The modern client's Boss trait list carries idx 1 (免疫能力下降), supporting only.
source_note: 4399 SPT page 2012-04-07: 血量8000（有待验证）, PP无限, 海洋之心无效, 伤害1/3回复自身.
